shutdown.where: the switch on the box under the inverter

notes.text: The 6 am jump from 18° to 21° brought on **42 minutes of backup heat**, about 19% of the day's heating energy. Starting the warm-up an hour earlier would likely let the heat pump do it alone.
From 1 pm to 3 pm the heat stayed off while the house rose to **22.1°, 1.1° over the set point**. That's the sun through the windows.
With the heat off from midnight to 5 am, the house cooled about **0.3° an hour at −1° outside**. Solar keeps this for every such night, so winters can be compared.
